metadata.title: Qwen3.8 Flash Next SGLang dual-Spark profile
metadata.description: Immutable binding to MiaAI-Lab's 1M YaRN profile: native TP2, modelopt FP4, NaN-safe SM121 QSA NVFP4 and FP8 KV, sticky token-0 abort and cache flush, ConnectX MessageQueue routing, automatic PLE placement, 28 request slots, MTP3, and exact NCCL 2.30.7.
